settings.deliveryInformation: Nationwide delivery across all 36 Nigerian states and the FCT. Same-day & next-day courier dispatch in Lagos, Abuja, Port Harcourt, and Ibadan. Standard interstate delivery takes 2 to 4 business days. Payment and delivery charges will be confirmed via WhatsApp before dispatch.

policyContent.shipping: We pack all tech accessories securely with bubble-insulated packaging. Orders are handed over to trusted logistics partners once confirmed. Tracking reference and dispatch receipt will be shared directly to your WhatsApp or email.
policyContent.returnsAndWarranty: Prince Paradise provides a 12-Month Manufacturer Warranty on chargers, power banks, and smart devices against manufacturing defects. Products must be returned in original packaging with proof of purchase. Physical damage, water ingress on non-waterproof items, and customer alterations are excluded.
policyContent.privacy: We respect your privacy. Customer names, telephone numbers, and delivery addresses collected during the WhatsApp order flow are used strictly for order verification, dispatch, and customer service. We do not sell or share your personal data with third-party advertisers.
policyContent.terms: All product descriptions, specifications, and prices are listed in Nigerian Naira. Submitting an order request on this website creates a non-binding reservation inquiry. Final stock availability, applicable delivery fees, and order confirmation occur directly with our verified sales team on WhatsApp before payment.
